description: Java class for handling global exceptions in a Spring Boot REST API project. Defines multiple exception handlers to manage different error scenarios and generate appropriate HTTP responses.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: Handles various exceptions globally for the REST API, providing structured error responses.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles NotFoundException and returns a 404 Not Found response with error details.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation errors from MethodArgumentNotValidException and returns a 400 Bad Request with field error details.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles all other exceptions and returns a 500 Internal Server Error with exception message.
